import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Define source file paths
    source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_14/test_0.csv"
    source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_14/test_1.csv"
    
    # Load source tables
    df_source0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path)
    df_source1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path)
    
    # Inspect schemas (for clarity, not mandatory)
    # print(df_source0.dtypes)
    # print(df_source1.dtypes)
    
    # Transformation plan:
    # - Source0 has ['PLAYER', '2017-18'] with salary info in '2017-18'
    # - Source1 has detailed stats keyed by ['#', 'Player', 'Team', ...]
    # - Join Source0 and Source1 on Source0.PLAYER == Source1.Player
    # - After join, rename columns and reorder to match target schema:
    #   Target schema:
    #   ['PLAYER': string, '2017-18': integer, '#': integer, 'Player': string, 'Team': string, 'GP': integer, 'MPG': float, 'FGM': float, 'FGA': float, 'FG%': float, '3PM': float, '3PA': float, '3P%': float, 'FTM': float, 'FTA': float, 'FT%': float, 'TOV': float, 'PF': float, 'ORB': float, 'DRB': float, 'RPG': float, 'APG': float, 'SPG': float, 'BPG': float, 'PPG': float]
    #
    # Note: 'PLAYER' and 'Player' are both present in target, and they are duplicates of the same player name.
    #       We keep both columns as is.
    #
    # Data types:
    # - '2017-18' is integer (salary)
    # - '#' is integer
    # - 'GP' is integer
    # - Other numeric columns mostly float
    
    # Merge on player name
    df_merged = pd.merge(df_source0, df_source1, left_on='PLAYER', right_on='Player', how='inner')
    
    # Convert data types as required
    # '2017-18' to int
    df_merged['2017-18'] = df_merged['2017-18'].astype(int)
    # '#' to int
    df_merged['#'] = df_merged['#'].astype(int)
    # 'GP' to int
    df_merged['GP'] = df_merged['GP'].astype(int)
    
    # Ensure other numeric columns are float
    float_cols = ['MPG', 'FGM', 'FGA', 'FG%', '3PM', '3PA', '3P%', 'FTM', 'FTA', 'FT%', 
                  'TOV', 'PF', 'ORB', 'DRB', 'RPG', 'APG', 'SPG', 'BPG', 'PPG']
    for col in float_cols:
        df_merged[col] = df_merged[col].astype(float)
    
    # Reorder columns to target schema order
    target_columns = ['PLAYER', '2017-18', '#', 'Player', 'Team', 'GP', 'MPG', 'FGM', 'FGA', 'FG%', 
                      '3PM', '3PA', '3P%', 'FTM', 'FTA', 'FT%', 'TOV', 'PF', 'ORB', 'DRB', 'RPG', 
                      'APG', 'SPG', 'BPG', 'PPG']
    
    df_target = df_merged[target_columns]
    
    # Write to target CSV
    output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_14/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
    
if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
